panelHTML:
CMDP view (cost = violating steps): analytical E[N] ≈ 0.232  |  sample mean 0.245 ± 0.039  |  budget d = 1.0  PASSES (analytical formula, evaluated numerically)
Chance view: P(any violation in the episode) ≈ 0.195 ± 0.028 (estimate)  |  level δ = 0.05  SAMPLE FAILS
Risk view: VaRα(Z) = 0.020, CVaRα(Z) = 0.050 (mean of the worst 10% of the 200 sampled excursions; must be ≤ 0)  SAMPLE FAILS
Hard view: worst sampled excursion max Z = 0.122 (must be ≤ 0 in every episode)  SAMPLE FAILS — with Gaussian noise the true probability of ever violating is positive, so "almost surely safe" can never hold; 200 clean samples are not a proof.
Analytic: stationary sd σ∞ = σ/√(k(2−k)) = 0.0808, stationary per-step violation probability p∞ = 1 − Φ((1 − 0.8)/σ∞) = 0.0067; Markov bound on the chance view: P ≤ E[N] = 0.232.
